name: gauntlet
description: Bounded multi-agent iterative refinement loop with frozen contracts, adversarial reviews, surgical merges, and plateau detection.

topology.flow: [Prompt] -> [Judge: Freeze Contract] -> [Builder: Write Diff] -> [Critic: Fresh Review] -> [Judge: Pass or Fix] -> (Fix -> [Integrator: Apply 1 Largest Fix] -> Critic | Pass -> [Complete])
